chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Lil Armstrong as a family friend and her Idlewild house
summary: Lil knew him as a baby in Memphis, he visited her Idlewild country house to relax, and she loved Louis until she died.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Oh, I knew Lil, right, right.
Ever since you were a child.
Right, ever since I was a child. She used to put diapers on me and she used to tell everybody, 'boy, I used to put diapers on you.'
This was in Memphis, see, this was

what she meant, right. Yeah, she was a grand woman, and then I went up to -- at a country place up in Idlewild, Michigan. And whenever I felt depressed or wanted to get away from it all, I'd run up there -- it's in the summer, and she'd cook and all of that.
Right, right, so she -- and she'd cook and everything and she loved that man til the day she died.
I know it was a very interesting relationship because she's good friends with Lucille.

Oh, yeah, she's a good -- right, right, she was a great friend of Lucille's, but she still -- and she always talked about Louis and their association and their marriage and all of this, and Louis just could do no wrong. And then whenever he would come -- like he was here at Revenue one year, and so she went up and she just a ball with him. Oh, Pops, you're crazy.
Right, and then until the day she died -- and then, this home up there -- she was going to will that to Louis, but he passed just before her.
Just a month or two before.
Right, but she was going -- that country -- because she said, he bought this for me, so I'm going to give it back to him.
